summary: All 6 Gherkin scenarios mapped to integration tests, plus domain unit tests (AlertJustification), handler unit tests (JustifyAlertHandler + EvaluateAlertsForTransactionHandler ceiling-suppression, 9 new), and the full mandatory security sweep (SQLi, auth bypass, IDOR) on the new /justify endpoint. Non-Gherkin additions per process item 1: a sequential-convergence stand-in for concurrent justify calls on the same category (TestClient is synchronous, so true concurrent threads aren't exercised -- this proves the ceiling converges on the max regardless of call order). Also added tests/features/FINTRACK-25-alert-justification-feedback-loop.feature, missing from PR #38 (Tech Lead gap -- fixed inline rather than filed as a separate bug, same-day same-pipeline omission). Full regression on PR #40 branch: 620 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped (330 unit + 146 integration + 144 security), zero change to the pre-FINTRACK-25 baseline (309/137/136), confirming FINTRACK-22's original alert suite is untouched. Module-specific coverage on new/modified FINTRACK-25 code: 93% (208 stmts, 15 missed -- the real SqlAlchemyAlertJustificationRepository adapter and the justify route's exception branches, under-reported by this sandbox's coverage.py for async coroutines, same known limitation as FINTRACK-23's QA envelope; all exercised by passing assertions). Real CI on PR #40 green: Test Suite + Security Scan both success.
